search_window.basis: Start is completed_at of immediately previous verified Care Line Watch heartbeat; includes newly posted official notices and newly verified concrete access-risk changes since then. Supplementary recall, not the authoritative production national collector.

findings.title: Revised notice to public of de-certification of Network for Hope (KYDA)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: CMS is extending the effective date of de-certification and termination of Network for Hope’s agreement to June 4, 2027
findings.service_line: Organ procurement / organ donation service-area coverage
findings.access_consequences: CMS revised a previously announced termination, extending the de-certification and Medicare/Medicaid organ-procurement payment cutoff to 2027-06-04 so the donation service area can transfer to another OPO. This delays an access-risk transition; it is not a new closure or evidence that patient services stopped today.
findings.affected_population: Hospitals, donor families, organ-donation and transplant stakeholders in Network for Hope's KYDA donation service area; population and service-area extent not quantified in the notice.
findings.qualification_note: New CMS notice revises an August 5, 2026 existing de-certification, rather than announcing a first-time termination. Treat as material effective-date modification, subject to Care Line review and production deduplication.

cms_public_notices.new_notice: Network for Hope OPO (KY; CCN 18P001) revised de-certification notice dated 2026-11-02. CMS states effective termination delayed to 2027-06-04 and will work on donation service-area transfer; PDF read and page visually inspected.
cms_public_notices.preexisting_original_notice: An earlier 2026-08-05 Network for Hope notice is separately listed by CMS; no new de-certification determination is asserted.
